تصطلقي (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِقِي (taṣṭaliqī) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# تُصْطَلَقِي (tuṣṭalaqī) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
